resources.string: Open recovery status / resolve an attempt
Self-update paused. Open Settings → LelloStore self-updates and recovery to finish setup or restore the companion connection.
The recovery companion keeps a protected copy of LelloStore and can repair a failed update. Set it up here; no catalogue download is needed.
Allow installs from LelloStore, then return and tap Install / update companion again.
Complete Android’s installation prompt, then return here for step 2.

Keep Android Settings and this screen visible in split screen. In Wireless debugging, request a fresh pairing code for the companion. Pairing LelloStore alone does not authorize the companion. If already paired, skip to step 3.
Self-updates enabled. Recovery readiness is checked before every self-update.
Self-updates disabled or companion needs an update.
Ready. Recovery holds this Store APK and its device identity, and its own connection works.

Updates require a newer signed LelloStore release in your server catalogue and follow your automatic-update preference. After a reboot, re-enable Wireless debugging. Last-resort recovery requires your confirmation and may erase LelloStore settings and login data.
